title: Synthetic education fixture
ielts_prompt: Some people think online learning should replace classroom teaching. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
full_text: Some people believe that digital lessons should replace classroom teaching. While online courses can widen access to education, they cannot fully replace the interaction that takes place in a physical classroom. This interaction helps learners test ideas and receive immediate feedback from teachers and classmates.
